item.tib: 'chi med yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrub las ma 'ong lung bstan lo rgyus rnam thar skal ldan snang ba'i pad tshal
item.coloph: de ltar 'chi med yab sras thugs sgrubs (sgrub) skor brda yig don bkrol le'u bcu bdun dang 'od ldan dbal chen gnyis kyi snyan rgyud bcas khyon kyi le'u sum bcu so lnga 'dug gong gi rjes 'dzin las skal ldan rnams dang phyi rabs 'gro ba yongs kyi don ched duH dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis sgrub gnas khyad 'phags ma d+hal ri khrod du lung bzhin phab pas dge legs 'phel rgyas shog yi ge pa ni dbra btsun tshul khrims dpal bzang mo'i (mos) sam b+hu tra las dag par zhal bshus so//
